主要研究子领域（OpenAlex）为 Astronomy and Astroph: Professors whose main OpenAlex subfield is Astronomy and Astrophysics: galaxies, star clusters, exoplanets, the interstellar medium and simulations.

物理、化学两系中主要子领域为凝聚态、电子/光学/磁性材料或材料化学的教授：中子与: Physics and chemistry professors whose main subfield is condensed matter, electronic/optical/magnetic materials or materials chemistry: neutron and μSR scattering, NMR, quantum magnetism, thermoelectric and solid-state inorganic materials.

方向子网：医学物理 · 放射化学 · 核医学: Theme: medical physics · radiochemistry · nuclear medicine
主要两个子领域中含 Radiation 或 Radiology/Nuclear: Professors with Radiation or Radiology/Nuclear Medicine among their two main subfields: dosimetry and imaging, PET radiopharmaceuticals, targeted radiotherapy (McMaster nuclear reactor and cyclotron).
方向子网：量子理论 · 原子分子光学 · 理论与计算化学: Theme: quantum theory · atomic, molecular and optical physics · theoretical and computational chemistry
主要子领域为 Atomic and Molecular Physics, and: Professors whose main subfield is Atomic and Molecular Physics, and Optics or Physical and Theoretical Chemistry: cold atoms, strong-field physics, quantum many-body numerics, electronic structure theory and machine learning for chemistry.
方向子网：合成化学：有机 · 无机 · 主族 · 金属有机: Theme: synthetic chemistry: organic · inorganic · main-group · organometallic
化学系中主要子领域为 Organic Chemistry 或 Inorganic: Chemistry professors whose main subfield is Organic Chemistry or Inorganic Chemistry.
化学系中主要子领域属于分子生物学、生物医学工程、生物材料、结构生物学或临床生化的: Chemistry professors whose main subfield is molecular biology, biomedical engineering, biomaterials, structural biology or clinical biochemistry.
方向子网：能源材料 · 表界面 · 环境化学: Theme: energy materials · surfaces and interfaces · environmental chemistry
化学系中研究电池/能源材料（固体 NMR）、表面与低维材料、光子学材料、大气与环: Chemistry professors working on battery/energy materials (solid-state NMR), surfaces and low-dimensional materials, photonic materials, atmospheric and environmental chemistry, and exposure science.
